Fun-ASR-MLT-Nano.desc: Tongyi Lab's 800M multilingual speech recognizer: 31 languages, trained on hundreds of thousands of hours of speech.

Fun-ASR-Nano.desc: Tongyi Lab's end-to-end speech recognizer, trained on tens of millions of hours of real speech; strong on Chinese, its dialects and English.

MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize.desc: 0.9B model that transcribes long multi-speaker recordings (up to 90 minutes, 50+ languages) and labels who spoke when, with timestamps and sound events.

Parakeet-TDT-0.6B-V3.desc: NVIDIA's fast 600M transcriber for 25 European languages; detects the language by itself.

Whisper-large-v3-turbo.desc: OpenAI's Whisper large-v3, pruned to 4 decoder layers: much faster, nearly the same accuracy, ~100 languages and translation to English.

BigBang-v1-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of BigBang-v1 (Endless Frontier), a model trained on verifiable frontier tasks in maths, science and code.

Huihui-Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-abliterated-Tu.desc: Ornith-1.5 with its refusals removed (abliterated) by huihui-ai. Uncensored: it will answer what the original declines.

Ornith-1.0-35B.desc: Ornith-1.0, a self-improving open model family for agentic coding, post-trained on Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5.

Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of Ornith-1.5, a 35B mixture-of-experts (3B active) agentic coding model trained with end-to-end self-improvement.

Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-I2I.desc: Prompt enhancer for Qwen-Image-2.1 editing: rewrites a short edit instruction (with the image in view) into the detailed prompt the image model works best with.
Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-I2I.usage: tai ask -m Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-I2I -f photo.jpg "make it winter"

Qwen3.5-35B-A3B.desc: Qwen 3.5 mixture-of-experts (35B, 3B active) with built-in vision: chat, reasoning, tools and image understanding.

Qwen3.5-9B.desc: Qwen 3.5 dense 9B with vision: a small all-rounder for chat, tools and images.

Qwen3.5-9B-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of Qwen3.5-9B: the same model, faster on the device.

Qwen3.6-27B.desc: Qwen 3.6 dense 27B with vision, tuned for agentic coding, frontend work and repository-level reasoning.

Qwen3.6-27B-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of Qwen3.6-27B: the same model, faster on the device.

Sage-A1.5-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of InternScience's Sage-A1.5, an agent model that delegates to subagents and checks its own progress on long tasks.

gemma-4-26B-A4B-it.desc: Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 mixture-of-experts (26B, 4B active), instruction-tuned; text and image input, 256K context.

gemma-4-31B-it.desc: Google DeepMind's dense Gemma 4 31B, instruction-tuned; text and image input, 256K context.

Hunyuan3D-2.1.desc: Tencent's image-to-3D model: turns one picture into a textured 3D mesh with physically based materials.

GLM-OCR.desc: Zhipu's OCR model for complex documents (tables, formulas, layouts), built on the GLM-V vision encoder.

MiniCPM-OCR-1.0.desc: OpenBMB's document parser: turns pages into structured text and Markdown; small enough to run on phones.

PP-OCRv6-Medium.desc: PaddleOCR's v6 text recognizer, medium tier: a few dozen million parameters that rival billion-parameter vision models on OCR.

PP-OCRv6-Small.desc: PaddleOCR's v6 text recognizer, small tier: faster and lighter than Medium.

Pp-Doc-Layout.desc: PaddlePaddle's layout detector (PP-DocLayoutV3): finds titles, paragraphs, tables and figures on a page before OCR.

Unlimited-Ocr.desc: Baidu's OCR model for long, many-page documents in one pass.

AceStep-XL-Base.desc: ACE-Step 1.5 XL (4B) base: full-quality text-to-music with lyrics, plus cover, repaint, extract and continue. Trained on licensed data.

AceStep-XL-Turbo.desc: ACE-Step 1.5 XL distilled to 8 steps: the 4B model's quality, much faster.
AceStep-XL-Turbo.usage: tai music -m AceStep-XL-Turbo "lo-fi hip hop, mellow piano" --instrumental --seconds 60 -x ace_step.bpm=85 -o beat.mp3

Foundation-1.desc: Text-to-sample model for producers: tempo-synced loops, one-shots and playable instruments from structured tags (instrument, timbre, effects, key, BPM).
Foundation-1.usage: tai music -m Foundation-1 "warm rhodes loop, 90 bpm" --seconds 8 -o loop.wav

SongGeneration-v2-large.desc: Tencent's song generator: full songs with vocals and accompaniment from lyrics and a style prompt.
SongGeneration-v2-large.note: Tencent's official repositories are gone; linked to an MLX conversion. No samples found.

YuE2-3B.desc: M-A-P's YuE 2: full songs with vocals from lyrics, plus covers and edits of melody and chords. Non-commercial licence.

KnowLine-35B-A3B-Gen1.5.desc: PelaAI's 35B mixture-of-experts yes/no and multiple-choice classifier: answers questions about a text as probabilities, without writing text.

KnowLine-4B-Gen5.5.desc: PelaAI's 4B classifier, the small sibling of KnowLine-35B.

d3.desc: vllm-sr's largest d3 decision model (27B class): tops the Jev Decision Index text board.

d3-edge.desc: Smallest d3 decision model (0.6B class), for the lowest latency.

d3-flash.desc: d3 decision model in the 9B class: close to d3's accuracy, much faster.

d3-lite.desc: d3 decision model in the 0.8B class.

d3-mini.desc: d3 decision model in the 4B class.

d3-nano.desc: d3 decision model in the 2B class.

Nemotron-3-Embed-1B.desc: NVIDIA's multilingual 1B text embedder for search and RAG.

Nemotron-3-Embed-8B.desc: NVIDIA's multilingual 8B text embedder: more accurate retrieval than the 1B.

Qwen3-Embedding-4B.desc: Qwen3 text embedder (4B): multilingual, long texts, strong on retrieval benchmarks.

Qwen3-Embedding-8B.desc: Qwen3 text embedder (8B), the largest of the series.

Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B.desc: Multimodal embedder on Qwen3-VL: puts text, images, screenshots and video in one search space.

Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B.desc: The 8B multimodal embedder: text, images and video in one search space.

R3-Embedding-0.6B.desc: Tencent's small embedder for picking the right agent skill for a request (recall stage; pairs with R3-reranker).

GLM-4.7-Flash.desc: Zhipu's 30B mixture-of-experts (3B active), the strongest of its class; good at agentic tasks and coding.

Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I.desc: Prompt enhancer for Qwen-Image-2.1: expands a short idea into the detailed prompt the image model works best with.
Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I.usage: tai ask -m Qwen-Image-2.1-PE-T2I "a fox in the snow"

Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct.desc: Qwen3 30B mixture-of-experts (3B active), 2507 update, no thinking: quick, capable everyday chat.

Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking.desc: Qwen3 30B mixture-of-experts, 2507 update, always reasons first: better at maths, science and code.

Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507.desc: Qwen3 4B, 2507 update: a small, fast chat model.

Qwen3-Coder-30B.desc: Qwen3-Coder 30B mixture-of-experts (3B active): agentic coding with 256K context.

Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of Qwen3-Coder-30B: the same model, faster on the device.

gpt-oss-20b.desc: OpenAI's open-weight 21B mixture-of-experts (3.6B active) reasoning model with adjustable reasoning effort.

Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B.desc: Qwen3 reranker (0.6B): re-orders search results by relevance to the question.

Qwen3-Reranker-8B.desc: Qwen3 reranker (8B), the most accurate of the series.

Qwen3-VL-Reranker-2B.desc: Multimodal reranker on Qwen3-VL: ranks text, image and video results.

R3-reranker-0.6b.desc: Tencent's reranker for agent-skill routing (rerank stage; pairs with R3-Embedding).

ERNIE-Image-Turbo.desc: Baidu's distilled ERNIE-Image text-to-image model: a single-stream diffusion transformer that is fast and good with text in images.

FLUX.2-klein-4B.desc: Black Forest Labs' fastest FLUX: generation and editing in one compact 4B model, under a second on a GPU.
FLUX.2-klein-4B.usage: tai image -m FLUX.2-klein-4B -i fox.png "the same fox in summer" -o summer.png --open

FLUX.2-klein-4B-Background-Remove.desc: FLUX.2 klein with fal's LoRA that cuts the subject out of a photo onto a clean background.
FLUX.2-klein-4B-Background-Remove.usage: tai image -m FLUX.2-klein-4B-Background-Remove -i photo.jpg "remove the background" -o cutout.png --open

FLUX.2-klein-4B-Object-Remove.desc: FLUX.2 klein with fal's LoRA that erases a highlighted object and fills the gap naturally.
FLUX.2-klein-4B-Object-Remove.usage: tai image -m FLUX.2-klein-4B-Object-Remove -i marked.jpg "remove the highlighted object" -o clean.png --open

FLUX.2-klein-4B-Outpaint.desc: FLUX.2 klein with fal's LoRA that extends a picture into a pure-green (#00FF00) border you add around it.
FLUX.2-klein-4B-Outpaint.usage: tai image -m FLUX.2-klein-4B-Outpaint -i green-border.png "extend the picture into the green border" -o wider.png --open

FLUX.2-klein-4B-Zoom.desc: FLUX.2 klein with fal's LoRA that zooms into a red-marked region and redraws it in detail.
FLUX.2-klein-4B-Zoom.usage: tai image -m FLUX.2-klein-4B-Zoom -i red-box.png "zoom into the red box" -o zoom.png --open

Krea-2-Turbo.desc: Krea 2 made several times faster: images in about 2 seconds, keeping style references, moodboards and LoRAs.
Krea-2-Turbo.note: Gated on Hugging Face (request access there); description and sample from Krea's blog.
captions: “A rabbit riding a motocross bike”, from Krea's blog

Qwen-Image-2.1.desc: Qwen's unified generation and editing model (7B image transformer): strong at text in images and instruction edits.

Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo.desc: Viggle's distilled Qwen-Image-2.1: 6 steps instead of 40, about 5× faster, hard to tell apart on most prompts; edits with 1–3 reference images.

SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT.desc: SenseTime's any-to-any model: understands and generates images, with stable multi-turn editing.

Z-Image-Turbo-CharacterDesignSheet.desc: Z-Image-Turbo with a LoRA for character design sheets (front, side and back views with a colour palette).
Z-Image-Turbo-CharacterDesignSheet.note: No Hugging Face page found; described from its name.
Z-Image-Turbo-CharacterDesignSheet.usage: tai image -m Z-Image-Turbo-CharacterDesignSheet "character design sheet of a young fox explorer" -o sheet.png --open

Z-Image-Turbo-Children-Drawing.desc: Z-Image-Turbo with ostris's LoRA that turns any prompt into a child's crayon drawing.

Z-Image-Turbo-Creating-Realistic.desc: Z-Image-Turbo with a LoRA tuned for realistic, photographic images.
Z-Image-Turbo-Creating-Realistic.note: Its model card is empty; described from its name.

Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512.desc: Tongyi Lab's CosyVoice 3: 9 languages and 18+ Chinese dialects, zero-shot voice cloning across languages.

MOSS-TTS-Local-Transformer-v1.5.desc: OpenMOSS's TTS with native 48 kHz stereo output and voice cloning.

MOSS-TTS-Nano-100M.desc: OpenMOSS's tiny 0.1B multilingual TTS for realtime speech; light enough for a CPU.

Qwen3-CustomVoice-1.7B.desc: Qwen3-TTS with preset voices you steer by instruction (tone, speed, emotion); 10 languages.
Qwen3-CustomVoice-1.7B.usage: tai tts -m Qwen3-CustomVoice-1.7B "Hello there, nice to meet you." -i "cheerful, a little faster" --play

Qwen3-VoiceDesign-1.7B.desc: Qwen3-TTS that creates a new voice from a written description, e.g. "a calm older man with a slight rasp".
Qwen3-VoiceDesign-1.7B.usage: tai tts -m Qwen3-VoiceDesign-1.7B "Hello there, nice to meet you." -i "female, british accent, low pitch" --play

VibeVoice-Realtime-0.5B.desc: Microsoft's streaming TTS: starts speaking in ~300 ms while text is still arriving, so a chat model can talk as it writes.

supertonic-3.desc: Supertone's fast on-device TTS: 31 languages, expressive, runs in real time on a CPU.

Arete-27B-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of Nous Research's Arete-27B: Qwen3.8-27B fine-tuned to answer politically sensitive topics with the facts instead of CCP framing, keeping its general and agentic skills.

gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of gemma-4-26B-A4B-it: the same model, faster on the device.

clef.desc: Cloudflare's 27B multimodal decision model, post-trained from Qwen3.8-27B: given a state (text, JSON, images or video) and typed questions, it returns a probability for every allowed answer in one pass, with no free-form text.

clef-flash.desc: Cloudflare's 9B Clef decision model, the small sibling of Clef with the same state-and-questions interface.

Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B.desc: NVIDIA's 30B mixture-of-experts (3B active), trained from scratch: a reasoning model whose thinking can be switched off, with up to 1M tokens of context.

flint.desc: Recursive's mixture-of-experts model for coding agents (39.8B, about 2.5B active): investigates codebases, fixes bugs, implements features and writes tests.

MOSS-Image-Base.desc: OpenMOSS's base text-to-image model: prompts can be natural language, tag sequences or JSON layouts that place text and objects.

Qwen3-ASR-1.7B.desc: Qwen's speech recognizer for 52 languages and dialects, with language identification; the larger of the two Qwen3-ASR models.

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.desc: The first open-weight Qwen 3.6: a 35B mixture-of-experts (3B active) with vision, tuned for stability, agentic coding and real-world use.

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: the same model, faster on the device.

Qwen3.8-27B.desc: Qwen 3.8 dense 27B with vision: strong at agentic coding, computer and browser use, and multimodal reasoning.

Qwen3.8-27B-heretic-ara-Turbo.desc: Tiiny's Turbo build of a decensored Qwen3.8-27B made with Heretic: it refused 0 of 100 test prompts where the original refused 99.

TRELLIS.2-4B.desc: Microsoft's 4B image-to-3D model: turns one picture into a detailed 3D asset, including open surfaces and complex shapes.

Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B.desc: The smallest Qwen3 embedding model: multilingual text vectors for search and RAG, 32K context.

Qwen3-Coder-Next.desc: Qwen's coding-agent model: 80B mixture-of-experts with only 3B active, for agents and local development.

gpt-oss-120b.desc: OpenAI's larger open-weight model (117B, 5.1B active): strong reasoning and agentic tasks, with adjustable reasoning effort.

HiDream-O1-Image-Dev.desc: HiDream's unified image model, 28-step Dev version: one transformer for text-to-image, editing and subject-driven images up to 2048×2048.

Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored.desc: A quantized Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo with no safety checker or content filter: 7B, 8-step text-to-image.
Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored.note: From the quantizer's card (abenzerps), not Qwen's.

Z-Image-Turbo.desc: Tongyi's distilled 6B Z-Image: high-quality pictures in 8 steps, with sub-second latency on a big GPU.

Kokoro-82M.desc: A tiny 82M-parameter TTS that sounds like much larger models and runs fast; 8 languages and 54 voices.

OmniVoice.desc: k2-fsa's zero-shot TTS for 600+ languages, with voice cloning and voice design.

Qwen3-VoiceClone-1.7B.desc: Qwen3-TTS base model that clones a voice from about 3 seconds of audio; 10 languages.
Qwen3-VoiceClone-1.7B.usage: tai tts -m Qwen3-VoiceClone-1.7B "Hello there, nice to meet you." --clone me.wav --clone-text "what I say in me.wav" --play

VibeVoice-1.5B.desc: Microsoft's long-form TTS for podcasts: up to about 90 minutes of conversation between several speakers.

VoxCPM2.desc: OpenBMB's tokenizer-free 2B TTS: 30 languages, 48 kHz audio, voice design from a description and controllable cloning.

MiniMax-H3-Turbo.desc: LightX2V's 8-step distilled MiniMax-H3: short video clips with sound from a prompt or a start image.
